# Quran Online Tarteel

> Online Quran academy (since 2010) teaching children under 18 and women in live one-to-one classes, taught only by female teachers. Families in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, the UAE and Pakistan. Every new student starts with 2 free classes.

Key facts: female teachers only, each with 10+ years of experience; 500+ children taught; 1-to-1 live classes; parents can sit in; plans of 2, 4 or 5 days a week; 30 or 45 minute classes (Tafseer 45 or 60); fees from $15 a month; WhatsApp +92 335 0548488.
